_comment: Callable model catalog. G_MODEL_KNOWN validates against this list. NEVER add default_for_skill / role / skills fields - the schema forbids them on purpose so this file cannot become a role-to-model assignment table. Main picks the model per spawn using the 'notes' capability hints below. Prices are USD per 1M tokens, verified 2026-09-23.

models.notes: Strongest. Use where a miss is silent rather than loud - adversarial reading across distant sections, spotting assumptions that read as true, holding one codebase consistent. 1.05M ctx, 128K out, cutoff 2026-04-30, reasoning low..max. 100x the price of luna: justify it.
Balanced. Good for formulaic-but-long work: filling a boilerplate, classifying into fixed buckets, mapping clauses to evidence. 1.05M ctx, 128K out, cutoff 2026-04-20, reasoning none..max.

Cheapest and fastest, newest cutoff. Good for high-volume constrained decisions where the option set is small and the state is already summarized. 1.05M ctx, 128K out, cutoff 2026-05-18, reasoning none..max. Raise reasoning effort before escalating tier.

Embedding model for the long-term Store only - never spawn a skill with this. 1536 dims, which is what pgvector HNSW can index (limit 2000d). text-embedding-3-large defaults to 3072d and CANNOT be HNSW-indexed without truncating via the dimensions param.
